description:
Correct the pages that describe issue visibility as a three-tier fallback through git `HEAD`.

## Background

Issue reads come from the checkout's own data root and, in a linked checkout, the primary checkout's data root. Four pages still describe a git `HEAD` tier:

- `docs/tutorials/parallel-work-worktrees.md:107` lists three tiers.
- `docs/how-to/multi-agent-coordination.md:202` draws them in a mermaid chart.
- `docs/how-to/troubleshooting.md:423` names `HEAD` as a cause, and `:436` suggests `git show HEAD:.jit/index.json`.
- `docs/reference/worktree-validate.md:172` names version-control history as a read source.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The four pages state that issue reads come from the checkout's own data root and, in a linked checkout, the primary checkout's, and none names git `HEAD` or version-control history as a read source.
- [hard] REQ-02: The troubleshooting remedies for a secondary worktree check those two sources and no longer suggest `git show HEAD:.jit/index.json`.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Issue visibility pages describe two read sources
